questions.question: Customer 1911 changed their mind about order 27414. Can they still return it, and what is the last day they can?
gold: Yes, it can still be returned (within 30 days of delivery)
The last day to return it is 2026-11-25

questions.question: Can customer 4226 still return order 21063?
gold: No, the 30-day return window has closed (delivered 2026-09-21, 49 days ago)

questions.question: Customer 3196 opened the Max Shampoo Bar from order 28429 and doesn't like it. Can they return it for a refund?
gold: No: opened Beauty items can't be returned unless they arrived damaged or defective (even though it is within 30 days of delivery)

questions.question: The Eco Dark Chocolate Bar in order 27559 arrived damaged and customer 2878 has already opened it. What can we offer?
gold: It is still eligible: damaged grocery items qualify even if opened (reported within 30 days of delivery)
A free replacement or a full refund including shipping (the order total is $38.37)

questions.question: Customer 4591 wants to cancel order 30390. Is that possible, and how much do they get back?
gold: Yes, it can be cancelled free of charge because it hasn't shipped (status paid)
A full refund of $176.97 (including shipping, to the original payment method within 5-7 business days)

questions.question: The customer changed their mind. Can order 29945 still be cancelled?
gold: No, it has already shipped (on 2026-11-08)
The customer can return it after delivery (within 30 days of delivery)

questions.question: Order 29987 is still pending. Was the customer charged, and what happens to the order if nothing changes?
gold: The customer was not charged (no successful payment; 2 failed attempts)
It is cancelled automatically 48 hours after it was placed (around 2026-11-09 19:26 ET)

questions.question: The Everyday USB-C Hub from order 3373 stopped charging. Customer 2387 wants their money back. Return or warranty?
gold: The 30-day return window has closed
It is covered by the 1-year Electronics warranty (until 2027-06-05)
Under warranty ShopFlow replaces it, or refunds the item price if no replacement is available

questions.question: The Classic Trail Runner from order 9700 has a manufacturing defect. Is it still under warranty?
gold: No, it is no longer under warranty (Footwear has a 90-day warranty, which ended 2026-10-11)

questions.question: Customer 3843 reports a defect in the Eco Plush Fox from order 18160. Can we still do anything?
gold: The 30-day return window has closed
It is still covered by the 90-day warranty (until 2026-12-02)

questions.question: Order 26063 arrived damaged and customer 2575 prefers a full refund. Who has to approve it?
gold: The full refund is $47.96 (including shipping)
A support agent can approve it (up to $100.00)

questions.question: Order 28793 arrived damaged and customer 2474 prefers a full refund. Who has to approve it?
gold: The full refund is $165.58 (including shipping)
A team lead must approve it ($100.01 to $500.00)

questions.question: Order 28460 arrived damaged and customer 4775 prefers a full refund. Who has to approve it?
gold: The full refund is $578.97 (including shipping)
Finance must approve it (above $500.00, via the finance-approvals channel)

questions.question: Order 28462 shows delivered but customer 3609 says it never arrived. Can we open a carrier investigation?
gold: Yes: it is within 14 days of the delivery date (deadline 2026-11-16; the 24-hour wait has passed)

questions.question: Customer 774 just told us order 25593 never arrived, even though tracking says delivered. Can we still open a carrier investigation?
gold: No: missing-package claims must be made within 14 days of the delivery date (delivered 2026-10-17; the window ended 2026-10-31)

questions.question: If customer 2216 returns order 28677 because they changed their mind, how much will they get back?
gold: $4.00 (the $9.99 item price minus the $5.99 return label; the original shipping is not refunded)

questions.question: Customer 2458 says the item in order 26690 is defective and wants a refund, not a replacement. How much do we refund?
gold: The full $54.98 (including the original shipping; no $5.99 return-label deduction)

questions.question: Customer 1655 saw the price of an item from order 29717 drop today. Can they get the difference back, and by when must they ask?
gold: Yes, a one-time price adjustment is allowed (within 7 days of the successful payment on 2026-11-05)
They must ask by 2026-11-12

questions.question: The price of an item in order 28423 just dropped. Can customer 2050 get a price adjustment?
gold: No, the 7-day price adjustment window has passed (payment succeeded 2026-10-28; the window ended 2026-11-04)

questions.question: Does customer 689 pay for standard shipping?
gold: No: the customer is VIP, and VIPs get free standard shipping (on every order)

questions.question: How much more does customer 4897 need to spend this year to become VIP?
gold: $91.27 more (completed purchases this calendar year total $908.73 of the $1,000.00 threshold; cancelled and refunded orders don't count)

questions.question: Customer 3050 says their cart was over $75 but they still paid shipping on order 13512. Were they charged correctly?
gold: Yes: after the $8.20 discount the order was $73.79, below the $75.00 free-shipping threshold (which applies after discounts; the customer isn't VIP)
$5.99 standard shipping was correctly charged

questions.question: Customer 2978 asks why they paid no shipping on order 9085. Was that correct?
gold: Yes: after the $8.90 discount the order was $80.08, at or above the $75.00 free standard shipping threshold

questions.question: How should we handle support ticket 1534, and how fast must we respond?
gold: It is a safety issue: priority urgent
First response within 1 hour
Tell the customer to stop using the product immediately
